faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find clear answers to common questions about our services, manpower, and operations.

services.question: What services does HBR World provide?
services.answer: HBR World provides comprehensive contracting services including civil construction, interior and exterior fit-out, MEP works (electrical, plumbing, mechanical, HVAC), facility maintenance, renovation works, and professional manpower supply across Saudi Arabia.

locations.question: Which areas in Saudi Arabia do you operate in?
locations.answer: We operate across all major cities in Saudi Arabia, including Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Makkah, Madinah, and other key industrial and commercial regions throughout the Kingdom.

manpower.question: What types of manpower can you supply?
manpower.answer: We supply skilled, semi-skilled, and general manpower including engineers, technicians, welders, operators, safety officers, drivers, helpers, and specialized construction professionals. All manpower is trained and legally compliant.

qualitySafety.question: How do you ensure quality and safety on projects?
qualitySafety.answer: We follow strict quality control procedures, international safety standards, regular site inspections, and continuous workforce training to ensure safe and high-quality project execution.

timeline.question: Do you guarantee project timelines?
timeline.answer: Yes. Each project is planned with a clear timeline, and we maintain transparent communication to ensure all milestones and deliveries are completed on schedule.

quotation.question: How can I get a quotation for my project?
quotation.answer: You can request a quotation through our Contact page, by phone, or via email. Our team will review your requirements and provide a clear and competitive quotation within 48 hours.

hero.title: Building Excellence Since 2009
hero.description: HBR-WORLD is a leading contracting and manpower supply company, delivering world-class solutions across Saudi Arabia.

story.title: Who We Are
story.p1: Founded in 2009, HBR-WORLD has grown from a small contracting firm to become one of Saudi Arabia's most trusted names in construction and manpower supply.
story.p2: Our journey began with a simple vision: to deliver excellence in every project we undertake. Today, with over 13 years of experience, we've successfully completed 200+ projects and deployed more than 3,000 skilled professionals across the Kingdom.
story.p3: We take pride in our ability to understand client needs, deliver on-time results, and maintain the highest standards of quality and safety in all our operations.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To be the most trusted and preferred contracting and manpower solutions partner in the Middle East, recognized for innovation, quality, and reliability in every project we undertake.

mission.title: Our Mission
